statement: The maximizer set is a singleton exactly under the strict largest-atom mass test and empty otherwise.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 2 < ν) : let D := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let f := fun z : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.stdLogLik x z.1 ν z.2 let strictMass := ∀ i, (TDist.multiplicity x (x i) : ℝ) < ν * ((n : ℝ) - TDist.multiplicity x (x i)) ((∃! p, p ∈ D ∧ IsMaxOn f D p) ↔ strictMass) ∧ ((∀ p ∈ D, ¬ IsMaxOn f D p) ↔ ¬ strictMass)
scope: Held df above two and nonempty finite sample.

statement: At df two the atom count decides between zero, finite positive or infinite likelihood. At infinity the limit is the matched normal likelihood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (μ : ℝ) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : let L := fun ν : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (TDist.stdLogLik x μ ν σ) let k := TDist.multiplicity x μ (3 * k < 2 * n → Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 2) (𝓝 0)) ∧ (3 * k = 2 * n → Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 2) (𝓝 (Real.exp (StudentFaces.fixedSdCollapseLog x μ)))) ∧ (2 * n < 3 * k → Tendsto L (𝓝[>] 2) atTop) ∧ Tendsto L atTop (𝓝 (∏ i, TDist.normalDensity μ σ (x i)))
scope: Fixed mean and positive standard deviation.

statement: A majority gives divergence. With no majority the best half-mass trace is unattained exactly when all finite fits lose to it. Exact opposite-pair blocks imply nonattainment.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : let D := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let F := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ StudentSlash.likelihood x p.1 p.2 let k := fun b ↦ SkewLSSlash.ties (fun i ↦ x i - b) ((∃ b, n < 2 * k b) → ¬ BddAbove (F '' D)) ∧ ((∀ b, 2 * k b ≤ n) → (∃ b, n = 2 * k b) → ∃ b, n = 2 * k b ∧ (∀ z, n = 2 * k z → StudentSlash.collapseValue x z ≤ StudentSlash.collapseValue x b) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn F D p) ↔ IsLUB (F '' D) (StudentSlash.collapseValue x b) ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, F p < StudentSlash.collapseValue x b)) ∧ (∀ {r : ℕ}, 0 < r → ∀ (d : Fin r → ℝ), (∀ i, 0 < d i) → ∀ (e : Fin r × Fin 4 ≃ Fin n) (b : ℝ), (∀ i, x (e (i, 0)) = b ∧ x (e (i, 1)) = b ∧ x (e (i, 2)) = b - d i ∧ x (e (i, 3)) = b + d i) → ¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn F D p)
scope: Joint location and positive scale for nonempty finite samples. A sample-index equivalence expresses the paired-block arrangement.

statement: Negative exponent gives a divergent vertical path. Critical exponent gives a sharp unattained finite supremum. Remote and positive-exponent ends vanish.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 2 < ν) : let L := fun m s ↦ exp (TDist.stdLogLik x m ν s) ((∀ b, TDist.exponent x b ν < 0 → Tendsto (L b) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop)) ∧ (∀ b, TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → let C := exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν) Tendsto (L b) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 C) ∧ IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L p.1 p.2) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) C ∧ ∀ m s : ℝ, 0 < s → L m s < C) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m s : ι → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < s j) → (Tendsto s l atTop ∨ Tendsto m l (cocompact ℝ)) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (m j) (s j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m s : ι → ℝ} {b : ℝ}, Tendsto m l (𝓝 b) → Tendsto s l (𝓝[>] 0) → (0 < TDist.exponent x b ν → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (m j) (s j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → ∀ B > exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν), ∀ᶠ j in l, L (m j) (s j) < B))
scope: Positive held df above two, nonempty finite sample and arbitrary indicated escape filters.

statement: Joint collapse at positive limiting shape vanishes at positive exponent and has the vertical upper bound at criticality when shape approaches from above.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v : ι → ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 q)) : let L := fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (a j) (0 < TDist.exponent x b q → Tendsto L l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b q = 0 → (∀ᶠ j in l, q ≤ v j) → ∀ B > exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b q), ∀ᶠ j in l, L j < B)
scope: Finite limiting location and positive limiting shape in ordinary scale coordinates. The critical branch is an upper bound.

statement: A vertical critical collapse reaches the exact positive boundary height when the shape displacement times log scale tends to zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : TDist.exponent x b q = 0) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 q)) (hr : Tendsto (fun j ↦ (v j - q) * log (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x b (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 (exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b q)))
scope: Ordinary scale at positive limiting df. The rate hypothesis specifies the sharp path.

statement: At infinite df and finite location and positive scale limits the likelihood tends to the matched Gaussian product.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v : ι → ℝ} {b s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝 s)) (hv : Tendsto v l atTop) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 (∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b s (x i)))
scope: Moving location, ordinary scale and df.

statement: At infinite df and zero scale the product vanishes when at least one limiting residual is nonzero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v : ι → ℝ} {b : ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l atTop) (hx : ∃ i, x i ≠ b) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)
scope: Moving location and ordinary scale. In the no-supercritical-atom regime every limiting location has a nonzero residual.

statement: Likelihood vanishes at infinite location or infinite ordinary scale uniformly over df at least one.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < a j) (hv : ∀ᶠ j in l, 1 ≤ v j) (h : Tendsto a l atTop ∨ Tendsto m l (cocompact ℝ)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)
scope: Ordinary scale, arbitrary filters and nonempty samples.

statement: A stationary feasible candidate at or above every actual boundary height gives attainment exactly in the absence of a supercritical atom.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.2.1 ∧ 2 < p.2.2} let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 p.2.1 (∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b, 3 * TDist.multiplicity x b ≤ 2 * n) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x z.1 z.2.2 z.2.1) p = 0 ∧ (∀ b s, 0 < s → (∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b s (x i)) ≤ L p) ∧ (∀ b s, 0 < s → TDist.likelihood x b 2 s ≤ L p) ∧ (∀ b, TDist.exponent x b 2 = 0 → exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b 2) ≤ L p)
scope: Uses the positive bijection from standard deviation to ordinary scale, and compares the entire face images, which is equivalent to comparing their suprema. The sufficient derivative-at-normal shortcut is separate.

statement: Unboundedness is equivalent to a supercritical atom. Otherwise the supremum of the Gaussian, Student-two and critical traces is the unattained supremum precisely when all finite fits lose to it.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.2.1 ∧ 2 < p.2.2} let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 p.2.1 let F : Set ℝ := {y | (∃ b a, 0 < a ∧ y = ∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b a (x i)) ∨ (∃ b a, 0 < a ∧ y = TDist.likelihood x b 2 a) ∨ (∃ b, TDist.exponent x b 2 = 0 ∧ y = exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b 2))} ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b, TDist.exponent x b 2 < 0) ∧ ((∀ b, 0 ≤ TDist.exponent x b 2) → IsLUB F (sSup F) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) (sSup F) ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < sSup F))
scope: The critical case includes positive-scale Student-two points in the face set, with each such point strictly losing to the critical trace by StudentFaces.lst_critical_joint.

statement: At the held mean, a supercritical atom is exactly the unbounded case. At lower mass, a feasible stationary point reaching the matched Gaussian and lower face gives a finite fit. The excluded height is the exact supremum if every finite fit loses.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) : let D := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (2 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x b p.2 p.1 let E := TDist.exponent x b 2 let F : Set ℝ := {y | (∃ a > 0, y = ∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b a (x i)) ∨ (∃ a > 0, y = TDist.likelihood x b 2 a) ∨ (E = 0 ∧ y = exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b 2))} ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ E < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ 0 ≤ E ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x b q.2 q.1) p = 0 ∧ sSup F ≤ L p) ∧ (0 ≤ E → IsLUB F (sSup F) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) (sSup F) ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < sSup F))
scope: The ordinary scale is free and the face comparison respects the held mean, including constant data away from that mean.

statement: A supercritical atom gives divergence. Otherwise a stationary finite fit exists exactly when it reaches the same-sd Gaussian and eligible critical collapse heights, including equality.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) : let D := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (2 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ exp (TDist.stdLogLik x p.1 p.2 σ) let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b 2 let F : Set ℝ := {y | (∃ b, y = ∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b σ (x i)) ∨ (∃ b, E b = 0 ∧ y = exp (StudentFaces.fixedSdCollapseLog x b))} ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b, E b < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b, 0 ≤ E b) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.stdLogLik x q.1 q.2 σ) p = 0 ∧ sSup F ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ b, 0 ≤ E b) → IsLUB F (sSup F) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) (sSup F) ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < sSup F))
scope: The ordinary scale shrinks at the df-two end, so the positive-scale Student-two face is absent. The statement uses the physical sd hold in its likelihood and derivative.

statement: No negative exponent and a stationary candidate reaching all critical collapse heights are equivalent to attainment.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : let D := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x p.1 ν p.2 (∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b, 0 ≤ TDist.exponent x b ν) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x q.1 ν q.2) p = 0 ∧ ∀ b, TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν) ≤ L p
scope: The critical subunit case uses compact superlevels. Strict-mass comparisons are vacuous.

statement: The joined decision distinguishes all strict masses, the balanced Cauchy pair and a feasible subunit stationary candidate reaching the largest critical height.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : let D := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x p.1 ν p.2 (∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b, 0 < TDist.exponent x b ν) ∨ (ν = 1 ∧ ∃ a b, a ≠ b ∧ 2 * TDist.multiplicity x a = n ∧ ∀ i, x i = a ∨ x i = b) ∨ (ν < 1 ∧ (∀ b, 0 ≤ TDist.exponent x b ν) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x q.1 ν q.2) p = 0 ∧ ∀ b, TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν) ≤ L p)
scope: Every held positive df is included.

statement: Negative exponent is equivalent to global unboundedness. Remote ends and positive-exponent collapses vanish, while critical collapse has a sharp finite vertical trace and joint upper envelope.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) : let L := fun m a ↦ TDist.likelihood x m ν a ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L p.1 p.2) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0))) ↔ ∃ b, TDist.exponent x b ν < 0) ∧ (∀ b, TDist.exponent x b ν < 0 → Tendsto (L b) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a : ι → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < a j) → (Tendsto a l atTop ∨ Tendsto m l (cocompact ℝ)) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (m j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ b {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a : ι → ℝ}, Tendsto m l (𝓝 b) → Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0) → (0 < TDist.exponent x b ν → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (m j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → Tendsto (L b) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν))) ∧ ∀ B > exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν), ∀ᶠ j in l, L (m j) (a j) < B))
scope: Moving location and scale at every fixed positive df.

statement: The fitted chart includes the Cauchy floor. A strict majority diverges. Otherwise a stationary or Cauchy candidate must reach the Gaussian and critical collapse faces, and equality counts.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.2.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2.2} let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 p.2.1 let F : Set ℝ := {y | (∃ b s, 0 < s ∧ y = ∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b s (x i)) ∨ (∃ b, TDist.exponent x b 1 = 0 ∧ y = exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b 1))} ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b, n < 2 * TDist.multiplicity x b) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b, 2 * TDist.multiplicity x b ≤ n) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, ((1 < p.2.2 ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x z.1 z.2.2 z.2.1) p = 0) ∨ (p.2.2 = 1 ∧ ∀ b s, 0 < s → TDist.likelihood x b 1 s ≤ L p)) ∧ sSup F ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ b, 2 * TDist.multiplicity x b ≤ n) → IsLUB F (sSup F) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) (sSup F) ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < sSup F))
scope: Ordinary scale and all fitted df at least one. The floor candidate is a conditional nuisance maximizer.

statement: Negative limiting exponent diverges at finite positive limiting shape. A critical exponent diverges or vanishes with the signed shape-log-scale rate.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 q)) : let L := fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x b (v j) (a j) let rate := fun j ↦ (v j - q) * log (a j) (TDist.exponent x b q < 0 → Tendsto L l atTop) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b q = 0 → (Tendsto rate l atTop → Tendsto L l atTop) ∧ (Tendsto rate l atBot → Tendsto L l (𝓝 0)))
scope: Fixed location and moving ordinary scale and shape; critical rates tending to either infinity are covered.

statement: At small df the joint likelihood vanishes for tie-free data at any positive scale, and for all data when scale stays bounded away from zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} (ha : ∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < a j) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝[>] 0)) (h : (∀ i, x i ≠ b) ∨ ∃ s > 0, ∀ᶠ j in l, s ≤ a j) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x b (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)
scope: Ordinary scale, held location and arbitrary positive-shape paths.

statement: At the all-tied normal corner every positive-scale approach to zero scale and infinite df diverges.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, x i = b) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l atTop) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x b (v j) (a j)) l atTop
scope: The tie location is held.

statement: A contact at held location produces a divergent path with df and scale both tending to zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) (hk : 0 < TDist.multiplicity x b) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x b t (exp (-(t^2)⁻¹))) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
scope: The exponential scale path works for any positive contact count, including the all-tied sample.

statement: A critical positive shape has a divergent path from below when df is unrestricted.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : TDist.exponent x b q = 0) : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x b (q-t) (exp (-(t^2)⁻¹))) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop
scope: The location is held and the path is eventually positive in both df and scale.

statement: At held location, contacts give divergence and the only surviving tie-free face is Gaussian. The joined statement specifies all shape and scale corners, including a divergent path from below a critical positive df.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) : let D := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun v a ↦ TDist.likelihood x b v a ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L p.1 p.2) '' D)) ↔ ∃ i, x i = b) ∧ ((∀ i, x i ≠ b) → (¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L q.1 q.2) D p) → IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L p.1 p.2) '' D) (SkewLSHalfT.normalFace x b / (2 : ℝ)^n)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ}, Tendsto a l atTop → (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < v j) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < a j) → Tendsto v l (𝓝[>] 0) → ((∀ i, x i ≠ b) ∨ ∃ s > 0, ∀ᶠ j in l, s ≤ a j) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ ((∃ i, x i = b) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ L t (exp (-(t^2)⁻¹))) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ (∀ q > 0, TDist.exponent x b q = 0 → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ L (q-t) (exp (-(t^2)⁻¹))) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} {q : ℝ}, 0 < q → Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0) → Tendsto v l (𝓝 q) → ((0 < TDist.exponent x b q → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b q < 0 → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l atTop))) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → Tendsto a l (𝓝 s) → Tendsto v l atTop → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 (∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b s (x i)))) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ}, Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0) → Tendsto v l atTop → ((∃ i, x i ≠ b) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ ((∀ i, x i = b) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l atTop))
scope: With no finite attainment and no contacts the exact supremum is the RMS Gaussian height. The separate signed-rate theorem gives the critical path behavior.

statement: The only competitive excluded face is the Gaussian at the supplied scale with mean at the sample average. A stationary point or a conditional Cauchy maximum reaches the face exactly when a fit exists.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let D := (univ : Set ℝ) ×ˢ Ici (1 : ℝ) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.likelihood x p.1 p.2 s let N := ∏ i, TDist.normalDensity ((∑ j, x j) / n) s (x i) BddAbove (L '' D) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ ∃ p ∈ D, ((1 < p.2 ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ TDist.logLik x q.1 q.2 s) p = 0) ∨ (p.2 = 1 ∧ ∀ b, TDist.likelihood x b 1 s ≤ L p)) ∧ N ≤ L p) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) N ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < N)
scope: The fitted df domain includes one. Positive-scale constant samples and finite face equality are included.

statement: A finite shape-log-scale rate shifts the log critical height by the off-atom count times the rate.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (b : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : TDist.exponent x b q = 0) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 q)) {r : ℝ} (hr : Tendsto (fun j ↦ (v j - q) * log (a j)) l (𝓝 r)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x b (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 (exp (((n : ℝ) - TDist.multiplicity x b) * r + TDist.collapseLogValue x b q)))
scope: Held location and any positive finite critical df, including approach from either side.

statement: A held-endpoint contact causes divergence. Without contacts, the only positive excluded face is the half-normal, optimized at the RMS scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) (_hsupport : ∀ i, b ≤ x i) : let D := Ioi (0 : ℝ) ×ˢ Ioi (0 : ℝ) let L := fun v a ↦ SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x b v a ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L p.1 p.2) '' D)) ↔ ∃ i, x i = b) ∧ ((∀ i, x i ≠ b) → (¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn (fun q : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L q.1 q.2) D p) → IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L p.1 p.2) '' D) (SkewLSHalfT.normalFace x b)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ}, Tendsto a l atTop → (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < v j) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < a j) → Tendsto v l (𝓝[>] 0) → ((∀ i, x i ≠ b) ∨ ∃ s > 0, ∀ᶠ j in l, s ≤ a j) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ ((∃ i, x i = b) → Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ L t (exp (-(t^2)⁻¹))) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} {q : ℝ}, 0 < q → Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0) → Tendsto v l (𝓝 q) → ((0 < TDist.exponent x b q → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b q < 0 → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l atTop) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b q = 0 → ∀ r : ℝ, Tendsto (fun j ↦ (v j-q) * log (a j)) l (𝓝 r) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 ((2 : ℝ)^n * exp (((n : ℝ) - TDist.multiplicity x b) * r + TDist.collapseLogValue x b q)))))) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ} {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → Tendsto a l (𝓝 s) → Tendsto v l atTop → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 ((2 : ℝ)^n * ∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b s (x i)))) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {a v : ι → ℝ}, Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0) → Tendsto v l atTop → ((∃ i, x i ≠ b) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ ((∀ i, x i = b) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (v j) (a j)) l atTop))
scope: For a compatible endpoint, the theorem specifies the joint shape-and-scale limits and critical finite-rate layer. The support hold is explicit.

statement: On the fitted df branch, a strict majority is exactly the unbounded branch. Remote and strictly subcritical ends vanish uniformly in slant.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.2.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2.2.1} let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood x p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b, n < 2 * TDist.multiplicity x b) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v α : ι → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < a j) → (∀ᶠ j in l, 1 ≤ v j) → (Tendsto a l atTop ∨ Tendsto m l (cocompact ℝ)) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v α : ι → ℝ} {b q : ℝ}, Tendsto m l (𝓝 b) → Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0) → Tendsto v l (𝓝 q) → 0 < q → 0 < TDist.exponent x b q → Tendsto (fun j ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v α : ι → ℝ} {b : ℝ}, Tendsto m l (𝓝 b) → Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0) → Tendsto v l atTop → (∃ i, x i ≠ b) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j)) l (𝓝 0))
scope: The upper estimate is the ordinary Student product times two to the sample size. Positive half-faces and optimized critical displacement are separate.

statement: The infinite-df face with finite slant and positive scale is the matched skew-normal along jointly moving nuisance paths.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v α : ι → ℝ} {b s β : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝 s)) (hv : Tendsto v l atTop) (hα : Tendsto α l (𝓝 β)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j)) l (𝓝 ((∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b s (x i)) * ∏ i, 2 * SkewLSGaussian.Φ (β * ((x i-b)/s))))
scope: Both finite location and scale are allowed to move, as is slant.

statement: The joint skew Student likelihood is continuous when all parameters converge at admissible finite df and positive scale.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v α : ι → ℝ} {b s q β : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hq : 0 < q) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝 s)) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 q)) (hα : Tendsto α l (𝓝 β)) : Tendsto (fun j ↦ likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j)) l (𝓝 (likelihood x b q β s))
scope: A local Student envelope dominates the CDF integral even for held subunit df.

statement: The positive-scale slant limits are the oriented half-Student or half-normal products with the limiting contact factor.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v α : ι → ℝ} {b s ε : ℝ} {t : EReal} (hs : 0 < s) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝 s)) (hε : ε^2 = 1) (hα : Tendsto (fun j ↦ ε * α j) l atTop) (hc : Tendsto (fun j ↦ ((α j * (b-m j) * sqrt ((v j+1)/(v j*(a j)^2+(b-m j)^2)) : ℝ) : EReal)) l (𝓝 t)) : (∀ q > 0, Tendsto v l (𝓝 q) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j)) l (𝓝 (TDist.likelihood x b q s * ∏ i, if 0 < ε*(x i-b) then 2 else if x i = b then EReal.rec 0 (fun u ↦ 2 * studentCDF (q+1) u) 2 t else 0))) ∧ (Tendsto v l atTop → Tendsto (fun j ↦ likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j)) l (𝓝 ((∏ i, TDist.normalDensity b s (x i)) * ∏ i, if 0 < ε*(x i-b) then 2 else if x i = b then EReal.rec 0 (fun u ↦ 2 * SkewLSGaussian.Φ u) 2 t else 0)))
scope: Both orientations, moving location and scale, and finite or infinite contact rate at finite or infinite df.

statement: The symmetric base of the skew Student likelihood has an exact critical atom layer with both displacement and df rate. Infinite displacement at a shape floor or a negative infinite rate gives zero.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : TDist.exponent x b q = 0) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v : ι → ℝ} (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 q)) : let L := fun j ↦ TDist.likelihood x (m j) (v j) (a j) let δ := fun j ↦ (m j-b)/a j let ρ := fun j ↦ (v j-q)*log (a j) let k : ℝ := TDist.multiplicity x b (∀ d r : ℝ, Tendsto δ l (𝓝 d) → Tendsto ρ l (𝓝 r) → Tendsto L l (𝓝 (exp ((n-k)*r + TDist.collapseLogValue x b q - (q+1)/2*k*log (1+d^2/q))))) ∧ (Tendsto ρ l atBot → Tendsto L l (𝓝 0)) ∧ ((∀ᶠ j in l, q ≤ v j) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ (δ j)^2) l atTop → Tendsto L l (𝓝 0))
scope: This is the symmetric product. Combining with the skew CDF factor supplies the skew layer.

statement: At a critical atom, the finite- and infinite-slant joint layer values are the symmetric displacement-and-rate trace times the corresponding CDF factor.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m a v α : ι → ℝ} {b q d r : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : TDist.exponent x b q = 0) (hm : Tendsto m l (𝓝 b)) (ha : Tendsto a l (𝓝[>] 0)) (hv : Tendsto v l (𝓝 q)) (hd : Tendsto (fun j ↦ (m j-b)/a j) l (𝓝 d)) (hr : Tendsto (fun j ↦ (v j-q)*log (a j)) l (𝓝 r)) : let K := exp (((n : ℝ) - TDist.multiplicity x b)*r + TDist.collapseLogValue x b q - (q+1)/2 * TDist.multiplicity x b * log (1+d^2/q)) let L := fun j ↦ likelihood x (m j) (v j) (α j) (a j) (∀ β, Tendsto α l (𝓝 β) → Tendsto L l (𝓝 (K * atomSlantFactor x b q β d))) ∧ (∀ ε : ℝ, ε^2 = 1 → Tendsto (fun j ↦ ε * α j) l atTop → ∀ t : EReal, Tendsto (fun j ↦ ((α j * (b-m j) * sqrt ((v j+1)/(v j*(a j)^2+(b-m j)^2)) : ℝ) : EReal)) l (𝓝 t) → Tendsto L l (𝓝 (K * ∏ i, if 0 < ε*(x i-b) then 2 else if x i = b then EReal.rec 0 (fun u ↦ 2 * studentCDF (q+1) u) 2 t else 0)))
scope: Finite scaled displacement and finite signed df rate. The infinite-slant clause allows infinite contact rates as well.

statement: Strict majority divergence, the exact finite-candidate comparison, and the unattained excluded supremum are joined on fitted df at least one.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) : let D : Set (ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ) := {p | 0 < p.2.1 ∧ 1 ≤ p.2.2.1} let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 let B := sSup (fittedFaces x) ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b, n < 2 * TDist.multiplicity x b) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b, 2 * TDist.multiplicity x b ≤ n) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, ((1 < p.2.2.1 ∧ fderiv ℝ (fun q ↦ log (L q)) p = 0) ∨ (p.2.2.1 = 1 ∧ ∀ b a β, 0 < a → likelihood x b 1 β a ≤ L p)) ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ b, 2 * TDist.multiplicity x b ≤ n) → IsLUB (fittedFaces x) B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: Face heights use sharp moving contacts and both critical slant classes. The proof exhausts all escapes by compactness of every superlevel strictly above them. Stationarity is expressed using fderiv.

statement: The fixed-slant normal and critical displacement heights give the exact finite-value comparison, including equality.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (β : ℝ) : let D := fixedSlantDomain none none let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 β p.2.1 let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b 1 let F := fixedSlantFaces x β none none let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b ∈ locations none, E b < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b ∈ locations none, 0 ≤ E b) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fixedSlantCandidate x β none none p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ b ∈ locations none, 0 ≤ E b) → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: The atom test uses the fitted df-one floor.

statement: With slant and df held, a negative exponent diverges and a critical displacement is the only nonzero excluded height.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (β : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) : let D := fixedSlantDomain none (some q) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 β p.2.1 let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b q let F := fixedSlantFaces x β none (some q) let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b ∈ locations none, E b < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b ∈ locations none, 0 ≤ E b) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fixedSlantCandidate x β none (some q) p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ b ∈ locations none, 0 ≤ E b) → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: All positive held df are included. Strict mass gives attainment since the excluded height is zero.

statement: With slant and location held, the matched skew-normal and held-contact critical collapse supply the exact comparison.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (β b : ℝ) : let D := fixedSlantDomain (some b) none let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 β p.2.1 let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b 1 let F := fixedSlantFaces x β (some b) none let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ y ∈ locations (some b), E y < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ y ∈ locations (some b), 0 ≤ E y) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fixedSlantCandidate x β (some b) none p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ y ∈ locations (some b), 0 ≤ E y) → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: Only exponent at the held location is tested, and a feasible df-floor candidate is included.

statement: The common held-slant theorem specializes to all three requested fixed-slant masks.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (β : ℝ) (μ ν : Option ℝ) (hq : 0 < ν.getD 1) : let D := fixedSlantDomain μ ν let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 β p.2.1 let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b (ν.getD 1) let F := fixedSlantFaces x β μ ν let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b ∈ locations μ, E b < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b ∈ locations μ, 0 ≤ E b) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fixedSlantCandidate x β μ ν p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ b ∈ locations μ, 0 ≤ E b) → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: Optional location and shape restrict both feasible points and escape faces.

statement: Held positive df leaves oriented half-t and critical collapse as the eligible nonzero excluded heights. The candidate comparison and equality rule are exact.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) : let D := freeSlantDomain none (some q) none let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b q let F := freeSlantFaces x none (some q) none let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ (none : Option ℝ) = none ∧ ∃ b ∈ locations none, E b < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ ((none : Option ℝ) = none → ∀ b ∈ locations none, 0 ≤ E b) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, freeSlantCandidate x none (some q) none p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ (((none : Option ℝ) = none → ∀ b ∈ locations none, 0 ≤ E b) → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: Location, scale and slant are free. The sharp moving-contact factor is two.

statement: The common decision with slant free removes each ineligible face under nuisance holds.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (μ ν ω : Option ℝ) (hq : 0 < ν.getD 1) (hs : 0 < ω.getD 1) : let D := freeSlantDomain μ ν ω let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b (ν.getD 1) let F := freeSlantFaces x μ ν ω let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ω = none ∧ ∃ b ∈ locations μ, E b < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (ω = none → ∀ b ∈ locations μ, 0 ≤ E b) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, freeSlantCandidate x μ ν ω p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ ((ω = none → ∀ b ∈ locations μ, 0 ≤ E b) → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: Includes held df, location and scale in arbitrary combinations, with positive held df and scale.

statement: The Student reverse hazard satisfies the strict power-tail inequality at every finite argument.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (z : ℝ) : 0 < q + z * ((TDist.density 0 q 1 z / ∫ y, TDist.density 0 q 1 y) / studentCDF q z)
scope: The bound controls the sign of each noncontact contribution in the critical skew scale derivative.

statement: At critical mass, every fixed finite slant strictly loses as positive scale increases.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b α : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : TDist.exponent x b q = 0) : StrictAntiOn (likelihood x b q α) (Ioi 0)
scope: The proof differentiates the exact log likelihood and uses the strict Student reverse-hazard bound.

statement: At held df and location, attainment is equivalent to positive exponent and both residual signs. Negative exponent diverges. Critical exponent and the single-sign positive case have an unattained excluded supremum.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) : let D := freeSlantDomain (some b) (some q) none let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 let E := TDist.exponent x b q let mixed := (∃ i, b < x i) ∧ (∃ i, x i < b) let B := sSup (freeSlantFaces x (some b) (some q) none) ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ 0 < E ∧ mixed) ∧ ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ E < 0) ∧ (E = 0 ∨ (0 < E ∧ ¬ mixed) → IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B) ∧ (0 < E → ∃! a, 0 < a ∧ TDist.scaleScore x b q a = 0)
scope: Both orientations and all contact counts are included, and the eligible symmetric conditional scale is unique.

statement: At positive held scale the likelihood is bounded and the matched skew-normal and both oriented half families supply the excluded heights.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) : let D := freeSlantDomain none none (some s) let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 let F := freeSlantFaces x none none (some s) let B := sSup F BddAbove (L '' D) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ ∃ p ∈ D, freeSlantCandidate x none none (some s) p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B)
scope: The face comparison includes equality, constant data, and moving-location contacts. The collapse branches are absent.

statement: At held location a majority of contacts gives divergence. Otherwise the matched normal, oriented half faces and critical held-location collapse serve in the exact comparison.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) : let D := freeSlantDomain (some b) none none let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 let E := TDist.exponent x b 1 let F := freeSlantFaces x (some b) none none let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ E < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ 0 ≤ E ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, freeSlantCandidate x (some b) none none p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ (0 ≤ E → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: The contact weight is one for the one-sided faces. Only a collapse at the held location is reachable.

statement: The weighted two-level Student cost has the exact reflected pair at balanced wide gaps. Its minimizer is unique in every other case, including zero counts and zero gap.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {Q D k l : ℝ} (hQ : 0 < Q) (hD : 0 ≤ D) (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hn : 0 < k+l) : ((k = l ∧ Q < (D/2)^2) → ∀ m, IsMinOn (twoLevelCost Q D k l) univ m ↔ m = D/2 + sqrt ((D/2)^2-Q) ∨ m = D/2 - sqrt ((D/2)^2-Q)) ∧ (¬ (k = l ∧ Q < (D/2)^2) → ∃! m, IsMinOn (twoLevelCost Q D k l) univ m) ∧ (k = 0 → ∀ m, IsMinOn (twoLevelCost Q D k l) univ m ↔ m = D) ∧ (l = 0 → ∀ m, IsMinOn (twoLevelCost Q D k l) univ m ↔ m = 0)
scope: The variable Q is the squared kernel width, and the levels are translated to zero and D.

statement: For any sample supported on two ordered levels, the maximum is a singleton except at balanced wide gaps, when it is exactly the stated reflected pair.

statement: Every held-df/scale location maximum is exactly a real root minimizing the kernel product. The polynomial is nonzero and its real roots form a finite nonempty set.

statement: Every all-free half-t maximizer is at the sample minimum and is an eligible score candidate. The entire maximizing set consists of the candidates tied at the top that reach both excluded faces.

statement: The normalized Student CDF lies in the unit interval.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: (ν z : ℝ) : 0 ≤ StudentSkew.studentCDF ν z ∧ StudentSkew.studentCDF ν z ≤ 1
scope: Used in the uniform fitted likelihood comparison.

statement: At every positive shape the normalized Student CDF is positive at finite arguments.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {ν : ℝ} (hν : 0 < ν) (z : ℝ) : 0 < studentCDF ν z
scope: Used in the log comparison and score arguments.

statement: The symbolic reflected sample has distinct finite global maxima on the fitted free-df chart, both with free scale and with scale sqrt(5)/2 held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {R : ℝ} (hR : (2:ℝ)^128 ≤ R) (ω : Option ℝ) (hω : ω = none ∨ ω = some (sqrt 5/2)) : let D := Student2Skew.freeSlantDomain none none ω let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood (reflectedSample R) p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 ∃ m s q α : ℝ, (m,s,q,α) ∈ D ∧ (m ≠ 0 ∨ α ≠ 0) ∧ IsMaxOn L D (m,s,q,α) ∧ IsMaxOn L D (-m,s,q,-α)
scope: The shape-one witness exceeds all centered fits and all excluded faces.

statement: The symbolic reflected sample has distinct finite global maxima on the fitted free-df chart, both with free scale and with scale sqrt(5)/2 held.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {R : ℝ} (hR : (2:ℝ)^128 ≤ R) (ω : Option ℝ) (hω : ω = none ∨ ω = some (sqrt 5/2)) : let D := Student2Skew.freeSlantDomain none none ω let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood (reflectedSample R) p.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 p.2.1 ∃ m s q α : ℝ, (m,s,q,α) ∈ D ∧ (m ≠ 0 ∨ α ≠ 0) ∧ IsMaxOn L D (m,s,q,α) ∧ IsMaxOn L D (-m,s,q,-α)

statement: At the atlas slant and location, the actual crossing has two separated global scales on the df-one floor even when df is fitted.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: : let A : ℝ := 2^20 let R : ℝ := 2^50000 ∃ D ∈ Ioo (1024*A) ((2:ℝ)^150*A), ∃ u v : ℝ, 0 < u ∧ u < 8*A ∧ 8*A < v ∧ IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood (largeSlantSample D R) 0 p.2 A p.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ici 1) (u,1) ∧ IsMaxOn (fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ StudentSkew.likelihood (largeSlantSample D R) 0 p.2 A p.1) (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ici 1) (v,1)
scope: Higher finite shapes are strictly beaten by a floor point. Exponent inequalities are symbolic in the enormous outlier.

statement: The cubic sigmoid bound gives an explicit lower bound for the large-shape normalizer score.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) : 1/(4*q^2)-1/(8*q^4) ≤ deriv TDist.logNormalizer q
scope: The error paired with the upper bound is one over eight times the fourth power of shape.

statement: The cubic normalizer enclosure is within one over 24 times shape cubed of the leading correction.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) : TDist.logNormalizer q ≤ -(log (2*π)/2)-1/(4*q)+1/(24*q^3)
scope: This is the terminal special-function enclosure for the exact interval comparisons.

statement: The log normalizer recurrence steps by two with an explicit logarithmic correction.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) : TDist.logNormalizer (q+2) = TDist.logNormalizer q+log (1+1/(q*(q+2)))/2
scope: Supports descending the terminal enclosure to the exact crossing shapes.

statement: An arbitrary finite two-unit descent yields the cubic terminal normalizer enclosure at any positive shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (j : ℕ) : let r : ℝ := q+2*j let S := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, log (1+1/((q+2*i)*(q+2*i+2)))/2 (-(log (2*π)/2)-1/(4*r)-S ≤ TDist.logNormalizer q ∧ TDist.logNormalizer q ≤ -(log (2*π)/2)-1/(4*r)+1/(24*r^3)-S)
scope: This implements the special-function part of the source interval checker, with residual width controlled by the shifted shape.

statement: An arbitrary finite two-unit descent yields the cubic terminal normalizer enclosure at any positive shape.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (j : ℕ) : let r : ℝ := q+2*j let S := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j, log (1+1/((q+2*i)*(q+2*i+2)))/2 (-(log (2*π)/2)-1/(4*r)-S ≤ TDist.logNormalizer q ∧ TDist.logNormalizer q ≤ -(log (2*π)/2)-1/(4*r)+1/(24*r^3)-S)
scope: Applies to the scalar interval comparisons with held standard deviation.

statement: The exact digamma-half-step score recurrence follows by differentiating the Gamma recurrence.
scope: This is the derivative enclosure descent used by the interval checker.

statement: A finite skew-t score cannot agree with a same- or different-hold skew-normal score on an observation neighborhood.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {m q α s b a β z : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) : ¬ (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, spatialScore m q α s y = deriv (skewNormalSpatialLogDensity b a β) y)
scope: Analytic continuation and Gaussian versus polynomial tail decay prove this comparison. Slant and nuisance location and scale are arbitrary.

statement: Finite and half-Student scores agree locally only at the same base Student parameters and zero slant.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {m q α s b v a z : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hv : 0 < v) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) (he : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, spatialScore m q α s y = deriv (fun t ↦ log (TDist.density b v a t)) y) : m = b ∧ q = v ∧ α = 0 ∧ s = a
scope: The oriented support restriction changes the height and leaves the base score on the strict-support branch.

statement: The three half-t scale-collapse detectors have both directions and supply exact admissible scale-zero paths.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {v b : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hb : ∀ j, b ≤ x j) : let H := SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x let k := TDist.multiplicity x (x i) ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ H p.1 v p.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2})) ↔ TDist.exponent x (x i) v < 0) ∧ (TDist.exponent x (x i) v < 0 → Tendsto (H (x i) v) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ H b p.1 p.2) '' (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0))) ↔ ∃ j, x j = b) ∧ ((∃ j, x j = b) → ∃ q > 0, Tendsto (H b q) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ H p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) '' FinishHalfT.domain x)) ↔ n < 2*k) ∧ (n < 2*k → Tendsto (H (x i) 1) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop)
scope: The joined theorem covers held positive shape, held endpoint with shape unrestricted, and free endpoint with fitted floor.

statement: The three half-t scale-collapse detectors have both directions and supply exact admissible scale-zero paths.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {v b : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hb : ∀ j, b ≤ x j) : let H := SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x let k := TDist.multiplicity x (x i) ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ H p.1 v p.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2})) ↔ TDist.exponent x (x i) v < 0) ∧ (TDist.exponent x (x i) v < 0 → Tendsto (H (x i) v) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ H b p.1 p.2) '' (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0))) ↔ ∃ j, x j = b) ∧ ((∃ j, x j = b) → ∃ q > 0, Tendsto (H b q) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ H p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) '' FinishHalfT.domain x)) ↔ n < 2*k) ∧ (n < 2*k → Tendsto (H (x i) 1) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop)
scope: The relevant branch allows any positive shape at the held compatible endpoint.

statement: The three half-t scale-collapse detectors have both directions and supply exact admissible scale-zero paths.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {i : Fin n} (hi : ∀ j, x i ≤ x j) {v b : ℝ} (hv : 0 < v) (hb : ∀ j, b ≤ x j) : let H := SkewLSHalfT.likelihood x let k := TDist.multiplicity x (x i) ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ H p.1 v p.2) '' {p | (∀ j, p.1 ≤ x j) ∧ 0 < p.2})) ↔ TDist.exponent x (x i) v < 0) ∧ (TDist.exponent x (x i) v < 0 → Tendsto (H (x i) v) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ H b p.1 p.2) '' (Ioi 0 ×ˢ Ioi 0))) ↔ ∃ j, x j = b) ∧ ((∃ j, x j = b) → ∃ q > 0, Tendsto (H b q) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop) ∧ ((¬ BddAbove ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ H p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) '' FinishHalfT.domain x)) ↔ n < 2*k) ∧ (n < 2*k → Tendsto (H (x i) 1) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop)
scope: The relevant branch uses the held positive shape and optimizes the endpoint.

statement: Once the right normal collar excludes score zeros, the actual stationary candidate set is finite, including the exact critical-mass case.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) (hc : 2*TDist.multiplicity x b ≤ n) (hTail : ∀ᶠ u in atTop, deriv (kernelProfile x b) u ≠ 0) : Set.Finite {u : ℝ | 0 < u ∧ 1 ≤ kernelShape x b u ∧ deriv (kernelProfile x b) u = 0}
scope: The only remaining premise for unconditional finiteness is normal-end exclusion.

statement: At exactly two-thirds held-mean mass the held-sd log score tends to minus infinity at df two.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b : ℝ) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 < s) (hc : 3*TDist.multiplicity x b = 2*n) : Tendsto (deriv (fun q ↦ TDist.stdLogLik x b q s)) (𝓝[>] 2) atBot
scope: This is the signed punctured critical collapse collar.

statement: Joined fixed-slant criterion, face comparison and compactness.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (β : ℝ) (μ ν : Option ℝ) (hq : 0 < ν.getD 1) : let D := fixedSlantDomain μ ν let L := fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ ↦ likelihood x p.1 p.2.2 β p.2.1 let E := fun b ↦ TDist.exponent x b (ν.getD 1) let F := fixedSlantFaces x β μ ν let B := sSup F ((¬ BddAbove (L '' D)) ↔ ∃ b ∈ locations μ, E b < 0) ∧ ((∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ (∀ b ∈ locations μ, 0 ≤ E b) ∧ ∃ p ∈ D, fixedSlantCandidate x β μ ν p ∧ B ≤ L p) ∧ ((∀ b ∈ locations μ, 0 ≤ E b) → IsLUB F B ∧ (∀ A > B, IsCompact {p ∈ D | A ≤ L p}) ∧ ((¬ ∃ p ∈ D, IsMaxOn L D p) ↔ IsLUB (L '' D) B ∧ ∀ p ∈ D, L p < B))
scope: Taking both location and df holds specializes the critical displacement to zero and removes the skew-normal face.

statement: At held location and positive shape, finite slant does not close the strict gap to the critical scale-zero trace.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) (b α : ℝ) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (he : TDist.exponent x b q = 0) : StrictAntiOn (likelihood x b q α) (Ioi 0)
scope: At fixed slant this retains the exact strict comparison on the scale-only chart.

statement: Held-df collapse sign, critical supremum and remote vanishing in actual standard-deviation coordinates.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hn : 0 < n) {ν : ℝ} (hν : 2 < ν) : let L := fun m s ↦ exp (TDist.stdLogLik x m ν s) ((∀ b, TDist.exponent x b ν < 0 → Tendsto (L b) (𝓝[>] 0) atTop)) ∧ (∀ b, TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → let C := exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν) Tendsto (L b) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 C) ∧ IsLUB ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ ↦ L p.1 p.2) '' (univ ×ˢ Ioi 0)) C ∧ ∀ m s : ℝ, 0 < s → L m s < C) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m s : ι → ℝ}, (∀ᶠ j in l, 0 < s j) → (Tendsto s l atTop ∨ Tendsto m l (cocompact ℝ)) → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (m j) (s j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (∀ {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι} {m s : ι → ℝ} {b : ℝ}, Tendsto m l (𝓝 b) → Tendsto s l (𝓝[>] 0) → (0 < TDist.exponent x b ν → Tendsto (fun j ↦ L (m j) (s j)) l (𝓝 0)) ∧ (TDist.exponent x b ν = 0 → ∀ B > exp (TDist.collapseLogValue x b ν), ∀ᶠ j in l, L (m j) (s j) < B))
scope: Specialize the joint comparison to the held mean for the vertical path and signed detector.

statement: If the oriented half-Student score and the finite score agree on a neighborhood, the compatible oriented face strictly beats the finite likelihood whenever there is a strict-support observation.
hypotheses_and_conclusion: {n : ℕ} (x : Fin n → ℝ) {m q α s b v a z ε c : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) (hv : 0 < v) (hs : 0 < s) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 1 ≤ c) (hSupport : ∀ i, x i = b ∨ 0 < ε*(x i-b)) (hSome : ∃ i, 0 < ε*(x i-b)) (he : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 z, spatialScore m q α s y = deriv (fun t ↦ log (TDist.density b v a t)) y) : likelihood x m q α s < TDist.likelihood x b v a * orientedWeight x b ε c
scope: This excludes equal-score finite/half-Student ties on the relevant noncontact strata.
